description: Weekly dependency updates. GitHub Actions come as one weekly PR; majors, and every change to charts/llamacloud, wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.

packageRules.description: Majors open only after approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
One weekly PR per manager for minor, patch and digest updates.
Some registries publish no release timestamps for digests; do not hold those updates forever.
All GitHub Actions updates in one weekly PR.

charts/llamacloud is a copy of platform's infra/charts/llamacloud that each BYOC release overwrites (utils/byoc/update-public-helm-chart-repo.sh), so a change made here alone is lost at the next release. The Dependency Dashboard lists these so the drift of the published chart stays visible; make the change in platform.
Our own images and charts move with each BYOC release, not with Renovate.
